rules.binary_labels: owner-authored positive/negative only; no detector outcome
rules.truth_absent: no magenta sheep entity present. A non-magenta cow distractor held static in the visible foreground at an exact world position may be present; it is NOT the detection target and does not change the binary absent label
rules.truth_present: magenta sheep present AND geometrically visible per Person C server as-built geometry at the reserved frame index

truth_authority: Person C owned geometry and authoritative capture condition
